info.name: SoundCloud — Inferno Grid | Orange-Only Dark Theme
info.description: Turn SoundCloud into a neon-orange listening space with a subtle glowing orange grid across a deep charcoal-brown background. This separate orange-only variation of Ember Orange Dark features vivid orange typography, illuminated SoundCloud branding, dark navigation menus with orange edge glows, orange album-art hover halos, and a waveform-style bottom player progress indicator using multiple shades of orange. Buttons, playlists, track rows, tags, search controls, and scrollbars share the same cohesive orange palette.
